items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: I work with Sam. I work with Isaiah. I work with Sam.

ctx.x: No, I don't remember. I've only been around here. I started coming around here in 1937, but I didn't move here until about six and a half years ago. I see. I see.

He died, but I still work with so many different other fella. Now they have a little fella. And then I work with Andrew Morgan's brother. Sam Morgan. Sam Morgan. Sam Morgan. I work with Sam. I work with Isaiah. I work with Sam. And I work with the saxophone player. And then I work with him. And they have another little kid that is real famous, which would be our... Sam Morgan. He's a... He's a... His brother's a great drummer. And he amitated Lewis Armstrong so much.
I have a... Speaking of recording, did you ever make any records?

items.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13
items.q: What was the first band you played with after the family band? Remember that? Sam Morgan. You played with the Sam Morgan band? Mm-hmm.

ctx.x: Born in New Orleans and the Trimmy.

Trimmy? Oh, I know. From Trimmy to the Rocky Green. Like London Avenue. 7-Watt, you know? What... Who taught you to play guitar? Now, who taught me how to play guitar? My father played guitar, you see? Yeah. But my first instrument, I used to pick up his guitar. Uh-huh. And all that harmony was right in my head. Yeah. Sure, I guess from listening to him, you pick up... Yeah, and definitely I would get beaten for fooling the guitar. Yeah. You know what I mean? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. But then I started out on the…
